entries.launchOwnership: SDK 0.3.0 readDispatchStatus interprets public statusVocabulary and independent wire booleans; false wins, missing booleans use vocabulary, and legacy launch aliases remain unknown. Parked receipts and resumed launches retain PR ownership across terminal deferred leases, including rekeyed heads. The recovery probe persists known resolved statuses and the secondary probe persists newly parked statuses under matching receipt identity; unknown status or unreadable retry evidence cannot erase the ownership observation. Positive resumed execution restores fleet capacity accounting, including matching rekeyed deferred leases. Confirmed terminal launch/retry evidence restores existing settlement/retry policy.
entries.preReceiptSemantics: CLOSERINTENT-01: query evidence includes bounded attempts, load-aware timeout, reason and detail for keyed and legacy reads; exact closer ticket required for adoption; absent/null ledger repository metadata is compatible, while supplied repository/head context must match; missing identity columns project as null; expired successful empty-key proof or audited empty closer-ticket proof settles keyed no-dispatch; new intents clear predecessor IDs. LAC-2081 / LEGACYINTENT-01: native fenced keyed receipt recovery or proof of no submission; legacy no-key attempts settle legacy-no-launch-proven only on a successful empty inclusive ticket/time ledger query recorded in preReceiptReconciliation.query; unresolved ownership holds only its PR/head, never fleet launch admission or capacity; keyless active listings retain stale/orphan escapes; authoritative closed/merged PR state retires intents as completed/pr-terminal without lease or budget changes; unreadable PR state holds without paging; inspection pages once per attempt; audited single-PR command defaults to dry-run
entries.reconciliation: Terminal launch observation writes launch-terminal; same-PR no-merge settlement releases ownership under existing caps after the readable 60-second terminal grace, with armed auto-merge held only inside the fixed 30-minute dispatched-lease window unless a no-merge audit resolves it; explicit watcher snapshot excludes proven terminal launches and unreadable evidence reserves bounded pending capacity.

entries.title: Hammer Stop Hold
entries.infrastructureRelease: Only all-infrastructure holds retire with infrastructure-stop; cleanup without a current stop returns none. Packaging stops and deferrals preserve earlier deterministic refusals until success; packaging-only audit history reasserts an unreleased persisted refusal without writing or paging when inputs are unchanged, including ownerless recovery; changed inputs record release and the new baseline. Closer preflight evaluates cleanup without audit history. Unknown or transient predicates prevent pure infrastructure classification. Mixed reasons retain the deterministic refusal with packaging reasons stripped. Released infrastructure holds return none without rewriting state. Release write failures log and preserve the in-memory decision.
entries.baseline: Comparable terminal audit head/base/mergeability readings, with mergeability trimmed and uppercased as for live metadata; other inputs, including the canonical closer review fingerprint, come from first observation or prior release, never synthetic eligibility-trace review fields. Review-required predicates additionally accept exact-head posted_at strictly after the terminal timestamp, including before first observation; this receipt requires a matching local posted row, so live bodies alone cannot provide posting-time release before SQLite reconciliation

entries.preReceiptReaper: LAC-2081: unresolved dispatching intents preserve leases and retry budget; native proof owns settlement; lease mutations share reclaim flock and compare expected owner
entries.parkedOwnership: LRQSTATUS-01: a matching terminal deferred lease continues to fence redispatch and inline daemon merge through resumed execution, including rekeyed heads; only confirmed terminal launch/retry evidence releases ownership
entries.reconciliation: Terminal no-merge launch on a confirmed live OPEN same head is reclaimable after the readable 60-second terminal grace (immediate without a timestamp), with armed auto-merge held only inside the fixed 30-minute dispatched-lease window unless a no-merge audit resolves it; merged success stays sticky. TERMLEASE-01 reclaims terminal superseded/failed-without-merge/deferred on the same pass with proven ended/absent launch; live or unproven launches hold. Superseded dispatches release matching rekeyed leases and retain the dispatch outcome.
